issue: Supplier payees become the same unnumbered [ORG] placeholder, so a task that must tell suppliers apart (for example 'which supplier is disputed') loses that distinction; only PERSON aliases are numbered by the current renderer. Column-dependent stable ORG aliases are not representable.

A cell-level edit (keep the row's ref and date but remove only the description and amount cells) cannot be expressed: section DROP covers whole clause/row units only and entity decisions cannot DROP. The row is therefore removed whole, which also removes the ref column value.
